abstract: Testicular germ cell tumors represent the most common malignancies in young males; 70% of patients with seminomas and 50% of those with nonseminomatous germ cell tumors (NSGCT) have clinical stage I at diagnosis. Lymphovascular invasion, embryonal-cell carcinoma component, absence of yolk sac histology and MIB1 proliferation rate represent predictors of micrometastatic diseasein stage I NSGCT. Therapeutic options following orchiectomy in patients with stage I NSGCT comprise nerve-sparing retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, surveillance or adjuvant cisplatin-based chemotherapy. All available treatment modalities produce excellent results, with a long-term survival of almost 100%. Consequently, therapy-induced toxicity is an important concern in the management of these patients. An individually tailored approach that takes into account the prognostic factor profile as well as the patient's preferences and their ability to comply with each one of the modalities is the key to the management of stage I testicular cancer.
abstract_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍は若年男性に最も多い悪性腫瘍であり、セミノーマの患者の70%、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍（NSGCT）の患者の50%が診断時に臨床病期Iです。リンパ管・血管侵襲、胎児性癌成分、卵黄嚢組織の欠如、MIB1増殖率は、病期I NSGCTにおける微小転移の予測因子です。精巣摘除術後の病期I NSGCTの治療選択肢には、神経温存後腹膜リンパ節郭清、経過観察、またはシスプラチン併用化学療法による補助療法があります。いずれの治療法も長期生存率はほぼ100%に達するため、治療による毒性が重要な懸念事項となります。予後因子のプロファイル、患者の希望、各治療法を遵守できる能力を考慮した個別化アプローチが、精巣がんの病期I管理の鍵です。
